name: Payee
description: A person who can be paid incentive compensation. The bridge from a platform user to the comp world. A payee holds a Position over a date range (PayeePositionAssignment); credit attaches to the POSITION and resolves to the payee who held it on the transaction's close date. Currency is a LOOKUP to Currency, not a loose three-letter string: a typo cannot silently create a second currency that sums separately.
